subtitle: When Stone Became a Mountain of Gods

panels.shot: low-angle wide of Kandariya Mahadeva looming at dusk with Vidyādhara a small silhouette at the base
panels.action: Vidyādhara Chandela stands at the foot of the towering Kandariya Mahadeva temple as its clustered spires surge upward like a stone mountain against a darkening sky, the sandstone glowing with the last light.

dialogue.text: In Vidyādhara’s time, a 31-metre mountain of stone rose at Khajuraho, its 84 spires and 800 beings flowing toward a hidden cave of Shiva—yet no inscription names the hand that built it.

i18n.hi: विद्याधर के समय खजुराहो में ३१ मीटर ऊँचा पत्थर का पर्वत उठा, ८४ शिखर और ८०० आकृतियाँ शिव की गुप्त गुफा की ओर बहती रहीं—पर शिलालेख में किसी कारीगर का नाम नहीं।

panels.shot: aerial bird’s-eye over the Western Group of temples amid fields and forest
panels.action: From high above, the Western Group of Khajuraho temples clusters on a low rise, surrounded by trees and scattered ponds, their soaring shikharas catching the bright central Indian sun.

dialogue.text: Around the eleventh century, Khajuraho was no quiet village shrine. It was a royal landscape of stone, where Chandela kings set their gods among ponds, orchards and palaces in the heart of Bundelkhand.

i18n.hi: ग्यारहवीं सदी के आस‑पास खजुराहो कोई शांत गाँव का मंदिर नहीं था, यह पत्थर का राजसी लोक था, जहाँ चंदेल राजाओं ने बुंदेलखंड के दिल में तालाबों, बागों और महलों के बीच देवताओं को बसाया।

panels.shot: mid-shot of Vidyādhara on a terrace, overlooking worksites in the distance
panels.action: Vidyādhara Chandela, in royal robes and simple ornaments, leans on a stone balustrade of his palace terrace, gazing toward a distant forested rise where scaffolds and half-built shrines pierce the horizon.

dialogue.text: Vidyādhara Chandela ruled in a tense age, balancing power between rival dynasties and emerging sultanates. Yet at Khajuraho, he turned resources not only to war, but to one vast temple of Shiva.

i18n.hi: विद्याधर चंदेल तनाव भरे दौर में राज करता था, जहाँ राजवंश और नए सुल्तान आमने‑सामने थे; फिर भी खजुराहो में उसने सिर्फ युद्ध नहीं, शिव के लिए एक विराट मंदिर पर भी धन बहाया।

panels.shot: close-up of a mandapa pilaster with the Virimda inscription, Vidyādhara’s hand hovering near
panels.action: A carved sandstone pilaster in the mandapa of Kandariya Mahadeva fills the frame, delicate incised Nagari letters of the Virimda inscription catching light as Vidyādhara’s hand hovers near it, not touching.

dialogue.text: On a mandapa pilaster, an inscription speaks of Virimda, widely read as Vidyādhara in later study. It praises a Mahadeva shrine—but leaves silent the architect and the many hands that shaped it.

i18n.hi: एक मंडप के स्तंभ पर लेख विरिम्द का ज़िक्र करता है, जिसे बाद के पंडित विद्याधर मानते हैं; वह महादेव मंदिर की स्तुति करता है—पर शिल्पी और असंख्य हाथों पर चुप रहता है।

panels.shot: architectural cutaway-style wide, showing the five-part plan aligned in perspective
panels.action: An overhead perspective reveals Kandariya Mahadeva’s plan: a projecting entrance porch, followed by successive halls leading geometrically toward the sanctum, all aligned on a single axis like a stone spine.

dialogue.text: This Mahadeva temple followed a five-part plan—entrance porch, mandapa, great hall, vestibule, sanctum—each space sliding into the next, drawing a visitor inward along a single measured line.

i18n.hi: यह महादेव मंदिर पाँच भागों पर बना—प्रवेश, मंडप, महान सभा, अंतराल, गर्भगृह—हर कक्ष अगले में फिसलता हुआ, यात्री को एक नापी हुई रेखा पर भीतर खींच लेता है।

panels.shot: low-angle close-up of the main shikhara framed by a forest of smaller spires
panels.action: From a low angle, the towering central shikhara rises sharply, encircled by clustered smaller spires that step up in tiers, their outlines merging into the silhouette of a single mighty peak.

dialogue.text: Above, a 31-metre shikhara grows from the halls like a stone peak. Around it, 84 subsidiary spires lock together so tightly that the whole temple reads as one rising mountain.

i18n.hi: ऊपर हॉलों से ३१ मीटर ऊँचा शिखर पत्थर की चोटी सा उगता है, चारों ओर ८४ छोटे शिखर ऐसे जमे हैं कि पूरा मंदिर एक उठता हुआ पर्वत लगने लगता है।

panels.shot: interior wide shot from dark hall toward glowing sanctum doorway
panels.action: Inside, from the cool shadowed mandapa, the viewer looks toward a small, glowing doorway of the sanctum, where a faint lamp glimmers, the path narrowing like a passage into a cave.

dialogue.text: Within, the halls grow darker, ceilings lower, air cooler. The measured corridor leads to a tight, cave-like sanctum, turning the mountain of stone into Mount Meru with a hidden heart of Shiva.

i18n.hi: अंदर जाते‑जाते हॉल अँधेरे, छतें नीची, हवा ठंडी होती है; नपी‑तुली राह अंत में तंग, गुफानुमा गर्भगृह पर पहुँचती है, जहाँ पत्थर का पहाड़ मेरु बनकर बीच में छुपे शिव को थामता है।

panels.shot: medium close on sculptors carving a block, chisel poised, temple mass looming behind
panels.action: A sculptor crouches over a sandstone block, chisel and mallet poised mid-strike, while behind him the unfinished mass of Kandariya Mahadeva rises in stages, scaffolding lacing its outer walls.

dialogue.text: The record does not name the designer, nor count the labour. But every jointed stone, carefully dressed and stacked without iron, shows how engineering and carving moved together toward the same rising form.

i18n.hi: किसी शिल्पकार का नाम नहीं, न मज़दूरों की गिनती; पर बिना लोहे के जड़े हर तराशे, जोड़े पत्थर दिखाते हैं कि इंजीनियरी और नक्काशी कैसे एक ही उठती आकृति की ओर साथ‑साथ चलीं।

panels.shot: detailed close-up of a wall band with multiple sculptural figures
panels.action: A richly carved exterior band shows gods, musicians, couples, warriors and attendants, all flowing in a continuous frieze that wraps around the projected wall surface and fades into the angle of a corner.

dialogue.text: More than eight hundred sculpted figures stride, dance, embrace and worship around the walls. Their bodies are not random ornament; they stream upward, echoing the climb of the 84 spires toward the summit.

i18n.hi: आठ सौ से ज़्यादा मूर्तियाँ दीवारों पर चलती, नाचती, आलिंगन करती, पूजती दिखती हैं; ये बस सजावट नहीं, ८४ शिखरों की चढ़ाई की तरह ऊपर चढ़ती देहों की धारा हैं।

panels.shot: dynamic upward tracking shot along a pilaster from base carvings to the roofline
panels.action: The eye travels up a single pilaster, from its lively base figures through poised celestial couples to the crisp mouldings near the roof, all aligned with mathematical precision into the larger vertical scheme.

dialogue.text: Scholars trace the alignment of mouldings and figures, the way each band fits a measured grid. The artistry lies in how this strict geometry disappears behind the easy flow of stone bodies and curves.

i18n.hi: विद्वान घड़ियों‑घड़ियों की सीध, आकृतियों की पंक्तियाँ, हर पट्टी का नाप जोखते हैं; कमाल ये है कि इतना सख़्त ज्यामिति भी पत्थर की सहज देहों और वक्रों के पीछे गायब हो जाती है।

panels.shot: interior medium shot of Vidyādhara standing in the mandapa, looking upward
panels.action: Vidyādhara stands barefoot in the mandapa, neck craned as he looks up at the high, ribbed ceiling, shafts of light falling from the entrance and touching the patterned stone ribs.

dialogue.speaker: vidyadhara
dialogue.text: Let this be a mountain where the people can climb without leaving the earth.

i18n.hi: ये ऐसा पर्वत हो जहाँ लोग धरती छोड़ے बिना ही चढ़ सकें।

panels.shot: exterior long shot, showing the temple aligned with the sun at early morning
panels.action: In early morning light, the temple stands aligned so that the sun’s rays fall along the main axis, slipping through the open mandapa lattice and lighting the passage toward the sanctum entrance.

dialogue.text: The temple’s axis, projections and recesses catch and break light through the day. The design does not only rise; it breathes with the sun, shadow and sky of central India.

i18n.hi: मंदिर की धुरी, बाहर निकले और धँसे हिस्से दिन भर रोशनी को तोड़ते‑पकड़ते हैं; रचना सिर्फ ऊपर नहीं उठती, वह मध्य भारत के सूरज, साया और आकाश के साथ साँस लेती है।

panels.shot: modern-day wide shot, with subtle hints of conservation scaffolding and survey equipment
panels.action: In the present day, slender scaffolds hug one side of the temple and a tripod-mounted survey instrument stands nearby, as conservators in helmets study the interlocked stone surfaces from a respectful distance.

dialogue.text: Recent conservation teams record every joint and crack, using measurements and 3D scans. They warn how this interlocked sandstone, so precisely balanced, is also vulnerable to time, weather and careless repair.

i18n.hi: हाल के संरक्षण दल हर जोड़ और दरार नापते, 3D स्कैन करते हैं; वे चेतावनी देते हैं कि इतनी बारीकी से संतुलित ये जुड़ा हुआ बलुआ पत्थर समय, मौसम और लापरवाह मरम्मत से भी टूट सकता है।

panels.shot: close-up of a conservator’s hand hovering near a weathered joint, Kandariya’s mass blurred behind
panels.action: A modern conservator’s gloved hand hovers near a weathered stone joint, the massive, tiered shikhara of Kandariya Mahadeva blurred in the background, towering beyond the fragile detail.

dialogue.text: In studying its joints and load paths, engineers see not just a shrine but an experiment in stone—a structure that holds because every piece shares the strain of the mountain above it.

i18n.hi: इसके जोड़ और भार के रास्ते पढ़ते हुए इंजीनियरों को केवल मंदिर नहीं, पत्थर की परख दिखती है—ऐसी रचना जो इसलिए टिकी है क्योंकि हर टुकड़ा ऊपर के पर्वत का बोझ बाँट रहा है।

panels.shot: twilight wide shot, blending past and present as silhouettes move along the plinth
panels.action: At twilight, local visitors and distant tourists walk slowly along the temple’s high plinth, their silhouettes framed against the glowing spires, while Vidyādhara’s ghostly figure seems to watch from the edge.

dialogue.text: Legends later tied Kandariya Mahadeva to battles and victories. The inscription itself stays quieter, leaving us with stone, shadow and the enduring climb from crowded sculpture to dark, silent sanctum.

i18n.hi: बाद की कथाओं ने कंदारिया महादेव को युद्धों और विजय से जोड़ा, पर शिलालेख शांत रहता है; वह हमें बस पत्थर, छाया और भीड़भाड़ वाली मूर्तियों से अँधेरे, शांत गर्भगृह तक की चढ़ाई सौंपता है।

panels.shot: final contemplative low-angle shot of the main spire disappearing into the night sky
panels.action: From a low angle at night, the central spire of Kandariya Mahadeva rises into a starry sky, its lower tiers barely lit, the apex dissolving into darkness as if merging with the heavens.

dialogue.text: Today Kandariya Mahadeva stands as proof that a ruler’s ambition, unknown engineers and many patient hands once turned pure structure into awe—a stone mountain where art and geometry climb together toward the unseen.

i18n.hi: आज कंदारिया महादेव साबित करता है कि एक राजा की महत्वाकांक्षा, गुमनाम इंजीनियरों और असंख्य धैर्यवान हाथों ने ढाँचे को ही विस्मय में बदला—एक पत्थर का पर्वत जहाँ कला और ज्यामिति साथ‑साथ अनदेखी ऊँचाइयों पर चढ़ते हैं।

subtitle_i18n.en: When Stone Became a Mountain of Gods
subtitle_i18n.hi: जब पत्थर बना देवताओं का पहाड़
